周末你有什么打算？ (Zhōumò nǐ yǒu shénme dǎsuàn?) - What's your plan for the weekend?
我早就想好了，请你吃饭、看电影、喝咖啡。 (Wǒ zǎo jiù xiǎnghǎo le, qǐng nǐ chī fàn, kàn diànyǐng, hē kāfēi.) - I made up my mind long ago: I'll treat you to a meal, a movie and coffee.
请我？ (Qǐng wǒ?) - Treat me?
是啊，我已经找好饭馆了，电影票也买好了。 (Shì a, wǒ yǐjīng zhǎohǎo fànguǎnr le, diànyǐngpiào yě mǎihǎo le.) - Yes, I've already found a restaurant and bought the movie tickets too.
我还没想好要不要跟你去呢。 (Wǒ hái méi xiǎnghǎo yào bu yào gēn nǐ qù ne.) - I haven't decided yet whether to go with you.
你一直玩儿电脑游戏，作业写完了吗？ (Nǐ yìzhí wánr diànnǎo yóuxì, zuòyè xiěwán le ma?) - You've been playing computer games all the time; have you finished your homework?
都写完了。 (Dōu xiěwán le.) - I've finished all of it.
明天不是有考试吗？ (Míngtiān bú shì yǒu kǎoshì ma?) - Don't you have an exam tomorrow?
你怎么一点儿也不着急？ (Nǐ zěnme yìdiǎnr yě bù zháojí?) - Why aren't you worried at all?
我早就复习好了。 (Wǒ zǎo jiù fùxí hǎo le.) - I reviewed it well long ago.
那也不能一直玩儿啊。 (Nà yě bù néng yìzhí wánr a.) - Even so, you can't keep playing all the time.
下个月我去旅游，你能跟我一起去吗？ (Xià ge yuè wǒ qù lǚyóu, nǐ néng gēn wǒ yìqǐ qù ma?) - I'm going traveling next month; can you go with me?
我还没想好呢。 (Wǒ hái méi xiǎnghǎo ne.) - I haven't decided yet.
你觉得哪儿最好玩儿？ (Nǐ juéde nǎr zuì hǎowánr?) - Where do you think is the most fun?
南方啊，我们去年就是这个时候去的。 (Nánfāng a, wǒmen qùnián jiù shì zhège shíhou qù de.) - The south; we went at just this time last year.
南方太热了，北方好一些，不冷也不热。 (Nánfāng tài rè le, běifāng hǎo yìxiē, bù lěng yě bú rè.) - The south is too hot; the north is a bit better, neither cold nor hot.
水果、面包、茶都准备好了， (Shuǐguǒ, miànbāo, chá dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le,) - The fruit, bread and tea are all ready,
我们还带什么？ (Wǒmen hái dài shénme?) - what else shall we bring?
手机、电脑、地图，一个也不能少。 (Shǒujī, diànnǎo, dìtú, yí ge yě bù néng shǎo.) - Mobile phone, computer, map: not a single one can be left out.
这些我昨天下午就准备好了。 (Zhèxiē wǒ zuótiān xiàwǔ jiù zhǔnbèi hǎo le.) - I got all these ready yesterday afternoon.
再多带几件衣服吧。 (Zài duō dài jǐ jiàn yīfu ba.) - Bring a few more pieces of clothing.
我们是去旅游，不是搬家，还是少带一些吧。 (Wǒmen shì qù lǚyóu, bú shì bān jiā, háishi shǎo dài yìxiē ba.) - We're going traveling, not moving house; we'd better bring less.
我吃完了。 (Wǒ chīwán le.) - I've finished eating. (only completion of the action)
我吃好了。 (Wǒ chīhǎo le.) - I've finished eating and enjoyed the meal. (action satisfactorily completed)
今晚的电影小刚已经买好票了。 (Jīnwǎn de diànyǐng Xiǎogāng yǐjīng mǎihǎo piào le.) - Xiaogang has already bought the tickets for tonight's movie.
饭还没做好，请你等一会儿。 (Fàn hái méi zuòhǎo, qǐng nǐ děng yíhuìr.) - The meal isn't ready yet; please wait a moment.
去旅游的东西准备好了吗？ (Qù lǚyóu de dōngxi zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma?) - Have the things for the trip been prepared?
我还没想好要不要跟你去呢。 (Wǒ hái méi xiǎnghǎo yào bu yào gēn nǐ qù ne.) - I haven't decided yet whether to go with you.
我一个苹果也不想吃。 (Wǒ yí ge píngguǒ yě bù xiǎng chī.) - I don't want to eat a single apple.
昨天他一件衣服都没买。 (Zuótiān tā yí jiàn yīfu dōu méi mǎi.) - Yesterday he didn't buy a single piece of clothing.
小丽一杯茶也没喝。 (Xiǎolì yì bēi chá yě méi hē.) - Xiaoli didn't drink a single cup of tea.
手机、电脑、地图，一个也不能少（带）。 (Shǒujī, diànnǎo, dìtú, yí ge yě bù néng shǎo (dài).) - Mobile phone, computer, map: not a single one can be left out (of what we bring).
我一点儿东西也不想吃。 (Wǒ yìdiǎnr dōngxi yě bù xiǎng chī.) - I don't want to eat anything at all.
这个星期我很忙，一点儿时间也没有。 (Zhège xīngqī wǒ hěn máng, yìdiǎnr shíjiān yě méiyǒu.) - I'm very busy this week; I have no time at all.
今天早上我一点儿咖啡都没喝。 (Jīntiān zǎoshang wǒ yìdiǎnr kāfēi dōu méi hē.) - This morning I didn't drink any coffee at all.
我一点儿钱都没带，所以不能买衣服。 (Wǒ yìdiǎnr qián dōu méi dài, suǒyǐ bù néng mǎi yīfu.) - I didn't bring any money at all, so I can't buy clothes.
他一点儿也不累。 (Tā yìdiǎnr yě bú lèi.) - He isn't tired at all.
南方一点儿都不冷。 (Nánfāng yìdiǎnr dōu bù lěng.) - The south isn't cold at all.
那个地方一点儿也不远。 (Nàge dìfang yìdiǎnr yě bù yuǎn.) - That place isn't far at all.
你怎么一点儿也不着急？ (Nǐ zěnme yìdiǎnr yě bù zháojí?) - Why aren't you worried at all?
我不想去看电影。 (Wǒ bù xiǎng qù kàn diànyǐng.) - I don't want to go to the movies.
那我也不去了。 (Nà wǒ yě bú qù le.) - Then I won't go either.
（明天的考试）我早就复习好了。 ((Míngtiān de kǎoshì) wǒ zǎo jiù fùxí hǎo le.) - (For tomorrow's exam) I reviewed well long ago.
那也不能一直玩儿啊。 (Nà yě bù néng yìzhí wánr a.) - Even so, you can't keep playing all the time.
周末我不想去商店买东西。 (Zhōumò wǒ bù xiǎng qù shāngdiàn mǎi dōngxi.) - I don't want to go shopping at the store at the weekend.
外边下大雨了，不能去踢球了。 (Wàibian xià dà yǔ le, bù néng qù tī qiú le.) - It's raining heavily outside; we can't go play football.
对不起，红色的手机已经卖完了。 (Duìbuqǐ, hóngsè de shǒujī yǐjīng màiwán le.) - Sorry, the red mobile phones are already sold out.
周末你有什么打算？ (Zhōumò nǐ yǒu shénme dǎsuàn?) - What's your plan for the weekend?
你怎么一直玩儿？ (Nǐ zěnme yìzhí wánr?) - Why do you keep playing all the time?
你怎么一点儿也不着急啊？ (Nǐ zěnme yìdiǎnr yě bù zháojí a?) - Why aren't you worried at all?
你能跟我一起去吗？ (Nǐ néng gēn wǒ yìqǐ qù ma?) - Can you go with me?
还是少带一些吧。 (Háishi shǎo dài yìxiē ba.) - We'd better bring less.
你是北方人吗？ (Nǐ shì běifāng rén ma?) - Are you a northerner?
我还没想好。 (Wǒ hái méi xiǎnghǎo.) - I haven't decided yet.
累了吧？ (Lèi le ba?) - You must be tired, right?
周末小刚打算做什么？ (Zhōumò Xiǎogāng dǎsuàn zuò shénme?) - What does Xiaogang plan to do at the weekend?
小丽要不要跟小刚一起去？ (Xiǎolì yào bu yào gēn Xiǎogāng yìqǐ qù?) - Does Xiaoli want to go with Xiaogang?
儿子在做什么？ (Érzi zài zuò shénme?) - What is the son doing?
他准备好考试了吗？ (Tā zhǔnbèi hǎo kǎoshì le ma?) - Has he prepared well for the exam?
小丽什么时候去旅游？ (Xiǎolì shénme shíhou qù lǚyóu?) - When is Xiaoli going traveling?
小刚觉得哪儿最好玩儿？ (Xiǎogāng juéde nǎr zuì hǎowánr?) - Where does Xiaogang think is the most fun?
为什么？ (Wèi shénme?) - Why?
小刚和小丽带了什么东西？ (Xiǎogāng hé Xiǎolì dài le shénme dōngxi?) - What things did Xiaogang and Xiaoli bring?
我觉得今天很冷。 (Wǒ juéde jīntiān hěn lěng.) - I think it's very cold today.
我觉得一点儿也不冷。 (Wǒ juéde yìdiǎnr yě bù lěng.) - I don't think it's cold at all.
我想吃一个苹果。 (Wǒ xiǎng chī yí ge píngguǒ.) - I'd like to eat an apple.
我一个苹果也不想吃。 (Wǒ yí ge píngguǒ yě bù xiǎng chī.) - I don't want to eat a single apple.
